Backend: Chapter 1 title is 'O sonho nasce' as expected
Backend: Admin PUT /api/admin/journeys/{journey_id} accepts story_chapters update
Backend: Admin PUT accepts story_emails_enabled toggle update
Backend: Admin PUT accepts current_chapter manual override

Frontend: Homepage shows 'CAPÍTULO 1', 'O sonho nasce' title, and chapter text
Frontend: Journey detail page /journey/journey_china001 shows StoryChapter component (light variant)
Frontend: Journey detail shows correct chapter title and text
Code Review: Admin.js lines 991-1052 has 'Storytelling Progressivo' section with 5 chapter editors
Code Review: Admin.js has 'Capítulo atual' indicator and 'Emails automáticos' toggle
Code Review: Admin.js chapter editors use data-testid='story-chapter-title-{1-5}' and 'story-chapter-text-{1-5}'
critical_code_review_comments: All Story Chapters feature code is correctly implemented
Backend: Journey model has story_chapters, current_chapter, story_emails_enabled fields (server.py lines 169-171)
Backend: check_and_update_story_chapter function correctly calculates chapter from percentage (server.py lines 3780-3824)
Backend: Email sending will gracefully skip if RESEND_API_KEY is not configured
Frontend: StoryChapter.js exports getChapterNumber() for reuse
Frontend: Admin.js has all 5 chapter editors with proper data-testid attributes
seed_data_creation: China journey pre-seeded with story_chapters (5 chapters), current_chapter=1, story_emails_enabled=true
context_for_next_testing_agent: Storytelling Progressivo feature fully implemented and tested. Backend APIs return story_chapters, current_chapter, story_emails_enabled. Frontend StoryChapter component renders on Homepage (dark variant) and Journey Detail (light variant). Admin edit form has 5 chapter editors with title input and textarea.
